items.summary: BLA (Blind LLM Agents) is an adversarial defense shield that protects binaries, Electron apps, JS bundles, Python, and WebAssembly against AI reverse-engineering agents like REA. It operates by filling the shipped build with decoys and limit traps, causing AI agents to hit their budgets and burn tokens. The tool uses a strategy of "Poison -> Exhaust -> Hallucinate" to disrupt automated reverse-engineering workflows while preserving 100% of original runtime behavior. It employs resource budget guards, opaque ternary guards, dynamic alias selectors, decoy SourceMaps, and various plugins to achieve this.

items.title: Pi-Remote
items.description: Remote control for your pi coding agent. Pi-Remote mirrors live pi terminal sessions to any browser, so you can watch runs, answer prompts, and send commands from your phone — end-to-end encrypted over a self-hosted relay.
items.summary: Pi-Remote is a pi.dev extension that allows users to remotely control their pi coding-agent sessions from a phone or any browser. It mirrors live pi terminal sessions to any browser, enabling users to watch runs, answer prompts, and send commands from their phone. The relay and iOS app are operated by Clever Cloud, and signing in requires a Clever Cloud account. The extension is open-source, with no build step or dependencies, and can be installed using `pi install git:github.com/CleverCloud/pi-remote-control`. The relay defaults to wss://pidev-remote.cleverapps.io but can be overridden. The iOS app uses Ed25519 device keys over TLS for pairing and operates alongside the coding-agent setup on users' machines.
